observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a silver and black camera with 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' visible on the body.
Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with a lens attached, including a shutter speed dial and aperture ring.
Photo 2 shows the camera, battery, battery charger, and two lens caps, one labeled 'TTArtisan 18-55mm 2.0'.
The camera has a vintage-style design with manual controls and a mirrorless body.
The lens appears to be a 18-55mm kit lens, not a dedicated mirrorless lens.
The battery is labeled 'Nikon ZA-1000', which is a battery for mirrorless cameras, not a lens.
The charger is labeled 'Nikon Battery Charger', confirming it is for a mirrorless camera.
The lens caps are not labeled as lenses, but the one labeled 'TTArtisan 18-55mm 2.0' is a lens, likely the one included in the kit.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: The model name 'Z fc' is visible in photo 0, but the 20.9-megapixel claim is not visible in any photo. The 'APS-C' sensor size is not visible. The 'retro-inspired, slr-style' description is subjective and not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and a video showing the lens focusing and aperture changing.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or not hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery charging and powering the camera.

risks.risk: The charger may not work or may be missing a cable.
risks.proof: A video showing the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up of the lens glass and aperture control.
Video of the battery charging and powering the camera.
Video of the charger connecting to the camera and charging it.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
